scope: Isolated B0/C0 generated native paired microbenchmark; no public reduction or original IREGI comparison. Frozen opt2 dependencies/generated opt3 codegen16;one combined all-type executable.
calibration: Separate2ms pilots choose one shared fixed iteration count;one timer pair per block;black_box input/output each call;no timing subtraction
order: Alternating baseline/candidate first,11/10 pairs. Exact f64 value/precision/signedzero checks before and after calibration and every pair.
all_type_before_after: 80 physical configurations plus guarded and direct alias/precision fixtures on identical binary;before/after CSVs byte-identical to initial qualification
